title: Build Biology Sentences: Structure and Function
objective: Students connect biological structures to their functions using reliable sentence patterns.
context: A plant cell has a cell wall. A cell wall helps support the cell.

items.prompt: Use “has” to say what the structure contains.
items.answer: A plant cell has a cell wall.

items.prompt: Explain one job of the part.
items.answer: The wall helps support the cell.

items.prompt: Join the part and its job in a sentence with “because”.
items.answer: A cell wall is useful because it supports the cell.
